name: Ultralight White Oak Accent, Black Felt
summary: Continuous white oak real-wood veneer laminated onto 9mm recycled black felt, with no MDF or rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec overrides photo estimates: two 300 mm panel pitches, each with a continuous 297 mm oak face and a 3 mm wide, 1.5 mm deep 90-degree V reveal at joins only; total depth is 9 mm, with oak color sampled from main.jpg and procedural grain. This 600 x 750 mm tile wraps in both directions, but the manufacturer says Accent cannot wrap a column; its 3000 mm maximum panel length also needs trim coverage on a full 10 ft wall.
